newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan to seek 200,000 T soft wheat - embassy.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to seek 200,000 T soft wheat - embassy.

text.p: Pakistan will tender on August 27 for 200,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat for September delivery, a Pakistan embassy official said.

"The invitation for bids has been issued today," the official said. "The tender we are soliciting on August 27 will now be only for 200,000 tonnes and not 350,000 tonnes," he told Reuters in a telephone interview from Washington D.C.
On August 15, Pakistan had been expected to tender for 350,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat which would have come from Australia, Canada and the United States.
The embassy official said the Australian Wheat Board apparently did not have enough supplies to participate in the tender.
The official said Pakistan had been expecting a significant portion of the wheat to be of Australian origin.
"But the Australian Wheat Board apparently does not have those quantities. Therefore, it was pointless for them to participate when they have no product to sell," he said.
The official added that the delivery date was now September 11-September 25 instead of September 11-October 10, as previously stated on August 15.
